description: Payment Village focuses on financial technology security, payment gateway architecture, Point of Sale (PoS) terminal hardware exploitation, EMV chip transactions, and online banking fraud.

talks.title: Identity Crisis: Online Account Opening Fraud
talks.teaser: Analyzes synthetic identities, mule networks, and automated bot attacks targeting new online account opening workflows.

talks.title: Architecting Modern Payment Gateways
talks.teaser: Covers architectural patterns, security controls, and regulatory compliance standards for engineering resilient payment gateways.

talks.title: Welcome to the Payment Village
talks.teaser: Welcomes attendees to DEF CON Safe Mode Payment Village, highlighting the talk schedule, workshops, and village goals.

talks.title: Online Banking Security
talks.teaser: Examines application layer security, transaction signing vulnerabilities, and authentication weaknesses in online banking platforms.

talks.title: Making Sense of EMV Card Data
talks.teaser: Decodes the complex transaction flow, cryptographic authorizations, and data elements embedded in EMV chip cards.

talks.title: PoS Terminal Security Uncovered
talks.teaser: Investigates hardware attack surfaces, firmware tampering risks, and memory scraping vectors in Point of Sale terminals.
